metadatos.descripcion: Personal finance without spreadsheets: log expenses over WhatsApp and see your free margin and per-category budgets.
metadatos.imagenAlt: Mango: “Your finances, one message away.” An expense logged on WhatsApp and the month's free margin.

inicio.descripcion: Mango sorts out your month: spending, income, savings and what you have left.
inicio.heroTexto: Mango sorts out your month, with fixed costs, budgets and savings, and tells you how much is still free. No spreadsheets.
inicio.historiaPaso0: This is your month in Mango.
inicio.historiaPaso1: Text it like you'd text a friend.
inicio.historiaPaso2: It understands and files it for you.
inicio.historiaPaso3: And your free margin updates instantly.

faq.pregunta: Does Mango connect to my bank?
faq.respuesta: No. You log what you spend, on WhatsApp or on the web. Mango never asks for bank credentials or sees your accounts.
No one. A language model reads each message to pull out the amount and the category, and the expense lands in your account. Only you can see it.
No. You can log and edit everything on the web. WhatsApp is the quick way to jot things down on the go.

faq.pregunta: Can I use Mango from Claude or ChatGPT?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Copy Mango's address from your account and add it as a connector in Claude or ChatGPT. Give permission once, then ask about your month or have it log things for you. Disconnect it whenever you like.
Nothing. Mango is free; if a paid plan ever comes, you'll hear about it first.

faq.pregunta: Does it work in my country?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Mango is in Spanish and English and works from anywhere. Amounts are shown in euros or Argentine pesos for now; more currencies are on the way.

privacidad.intro: Mango stores the minimum it needs to work and never sells or shares your data for advertising.

secciones.texto: Your e-mail, so you can sign in. If you link WhatsApp, your phone number. And what you log: expenses, income, savings, categories, budgets and fixed costs.

secciones.titulo: If you sign in with Google
secciones.texto: Google gives us your name and your e-mail, and nothing else: not your contacts, your calendar or your photo. You can change the name when you create your account. Mango never posts anything to your Google account.

secciones.titulo: If you connect Claude or ChatGPT
secciones.texto: If you connect your assistant to Mango, you approve it on a Mango screen, and from then on it can see and change your movements, categories, fixed charges and cards, as you would; never delete your account or change your profile. What the assistant reads goes through that assistant's company (Anthropic or OpenAI) under its own terms. You can disconnect it any time from Account, in Mango, and it loses access at that moment.

When you text the bot, the message is sent to a language model (Google's Gemini, on a paid account whose content Google does not use for training) to extract the amount, the description and the category. Mango stores the resulting entry. The message text is not kept, except on accounts with conversation history enabled, where it is kept for 30 days so the bot remembers recent context. For each message Mango also keeps, without the text, what the bot did with it (for example, whether it logged it or did not understand it) and how long it took, for 90 days, to improve the bot.
Mango does not connect to your bank or ask for credentials. It only knows what you log.

The database runs on Supabase and the website on Vercel. Sign-in codes are sent through Resend and WhatsApp messages go through Meta's official API. None of them receive your data for anything other than providing that service. If you connect Claude or ChatGPT, what the assistant reads also goes through Anthropic or OpenAI, under their terms.

Only the necessary ones: your session, the one that remembers your language and, if you sign in with Google, one that lasts ten minutes to carry your language, your timezone and the page you return to after signing in. No advertising or tracking cookies.
You can ask for a copy of your data or have your account deleted with everything in it. Write to {correo} and it is done within a few days.
